---
title: "Filter rows and add columns"
---

Keep the orders with a positive quantity and add a line total and a size
label to each.

{{< include pages/_filter-and-mutate.md >}}

- `filter()` keeps the rows for which the row closure returns `true`.
- `mutate()` adds one column for each named argument.
- A row closure such as `fn ($r) => $r->qty * $r->price` runs once per row
  and reads the row's columns as properties.
- A column expression such as `col('qty')->ge(20)` works on the whole column.
  `if_else()` takes one and picks `'bulk'` or `'single'` for each row.

Reference: [Single-table functions](../reference/single-table.qmd) ·
